verdict.rationale: A document-processing API could plausibly offer a test or sandbox mode, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a sandbox environment isolated from production data. The 'Try in playground' link and the single-container or on-prem deployment claims cover interactive trial use and data residency, which are adjacent features and not a documented sandbox or test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
